observation: Owner reports invisible Ghost Samurai body after0.3.13 violet-art integration; no new screenshot was supplied for this report.
cause: SpectralSpriteCutouts copied ModContent.Request<Texture2D>(path).Value using default AsyncLoad, then permanently cached its pixels. Installed ReLogic Asset<T>.Value returns DefaultValue while pending. The unrequested violet atlas can therefore become a cached transparent placeholder even after the actual asset loads. PreDraw correctly invokes the custom body renderer before suppressing native drawing; it was drawing the cached empty texture.
fix: Use ImmediateLoad on the first drawing-thread cache miss before dimensions/pixel readback. Keep existing key removal, owned cache and queued captured-instance disposal. BodyOpacity retains55% before synchronization and reaches100% at24ticks. No new graphics initialization in worker loading or on a server.
